Definition: middle voice from G1909 and G1299; to appoint besides, i.e. supplement (as a codicil):--add to.
BiblicalUsage: Epidiatassomai means to add to a covenant, to appoint besides — and Paul says no man disannulleth or addeth thereto once a covenant is confirmed. God's promise to Abraham cannot be edited by the law that came four hundred years later.
TheologicalSignificance: The covenant stands as God made it, I hold: no codicil, no addition, no fine print added later — the promise is the promise.
